title: Ask the AI clinical agent
summary: Ask about the last procedure, what's due today or the patient's alerts, and have it prepare the session.

steps.title: Menu → My Workspace
steps.details: The doctor's view: their schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.

steps.title: Choose the patient's appointment
steps.details: Tap the appointment on the schedule: the patient panel opens on the right. If you don't see appointments, change the day or the period at the top.

steps.title: Clinical agent
steps.details: It knows the appointment and the patient's history. Use the shortcuts (the last thing done, what's due today, alerts) or type or dictate your question. It can prepare the clinical session or mark the odontogram: you always review it before saving.
